steps.title: Setup Android Project
steps.description: Initializes the Android project structure and configuration files with the specified environment settings.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Generates the API schema indicating that no online backend is required for this application.

steps.title: Design Main Layout (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Creates the user interface layout for the main activity, including an ImageView for displaying the image, a button for image selection, a SeekBar for tint intensity, and buttons for selecting tint colors.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java Structure
steps.description: Sets up the basic structure of MainActivity.java, including UI element declarations and the onCreate method.

steps.title: Request Permissions for Image Access
steps.description: Adds runtime permission request logic for READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE to allow the app to select images from the device gallery.

steps.title: Implement Image Selection Functionality
steps.description: Adds code to MainActivity.java to handle picking an image from the device's gallery using an Intent and displaying it in the ImageView.

steps.title: Initialize Tinting Controls
steps.description: Sets up initial state for tint color (default to red) and tint intensity (default to 100%).

steps.title: Implement Color Selection Buttons
steps.description: Adds OnClickListener implementations for the color buttons to update the current tint color.

steps.title: Implement Tint Intensity SeekBar
steps.description: Adds OnSeekBarChangeListener to dynamically adjust the tint color's alpha based on the SeekBar's progress.

steps.title: Apply Image Tinting Logic
steps.description: Creates a method to apply the selected tint color and intensity to the loaded image using setColorFilter with PorterDuff.Mode.MULTIPLY.

steps.title: Refine UI and User Experience
steps.description: Ensures all UI elements are properly linked and provide a responsive user experience for image loading and tint application.

steps.title: Building TintMaster
steps.description: Compiles and packages the application into an APK for installation and testing.
